excerpts:
Apollo Africa Leadership Foundation (AALF) 2026 Campus Ambassadors Programme.

June 27, 2026 1 minute read
The Apollo Africa Leadership Foundation (AALF) has called for applications for its 2026 Campus Ambassadors Program.
The AALF Campus Ambassadors Program will reward passionate student leaders with cash prizes, gadgets, gifts, as well as internship, mentorship, and networking opportunities.

Eligibility Requirements

To be considered for the Apollo Africa Leadership Foundation Campus Ambassadors Program, you must:
* be individuals passionate about youth empowerment, tech & innovation
* be current undergraduate students
* be student leaders, influencers, and community builders.
* have strong communicators with a passion for impact
* be students eager to grow their network and leadership experience.

Benefits

As an AALF Campus Ambassador, you will enjoy the following rewards;
* Cash prizes and performance rewards
* Opportunity to win devices and exciting gifts
* Exclusive AALF merchandise
* Publicity and recognition across AALF platforms
* Access to internship opportunities
* Mentorship and networking with industry leaders and changemakers

Roles

As a campus ambassador, you will;
* Represent AALF on your campus
* Organize student-focused initiatives and events
* Build and engage a vibrant student community
* Connect students to opportunities that matter

Method of Application

* browser-use/browser-agent-template: Fork-and-deploy Vercel eve agent that browses the web with a Browser Use cloud browser.
* browser-use/jev-ultrafast: Fastest and cheapest web agent

Tokyo, November 2, 2026 — TIER IV , the pioneering force behind Autoware, open-source software for autonomous driving, today announced its commitment to spearheading Autoware 2.0 initiatives in collaboration with the Autoware Foundation (AWF) and the global open-source community. About BigUp

BigUp is a live sports streaming platform where fans watch together and predict the game. Creators stream with real-time stats while fans call what happens next. About the Program Campus Captains is BigUp’s campus ambassador program. The goal is to build a network of college students who grow awareness of BigUp and bring new fans to the platform, starting with one Captain per university.

The Role

Captains become the voice of their school’s sports scene on BigUp. Each one owns live game commentary, a school BigUp social account, and on-campus watch parties.

Live Commentary:

Stream fan-first commentary during your school’s games on BigUp, the student alternative to the university’s radio broadcast. Cover home and away games (football and basketball to start), engage viewers in chat in real time, and promote upcoming streams across campus and on social.

School Social Account:

Run your school’s BigUp account (@bigup.[school]) and post up to 5 times a week on Instagram across our content pillars: street interviews, meme dumps, sports graphics and slideshows, sports highlights, and campus content. Better together.

We believe that all members of our community should be informed, involved, and empowered in their PKU journey. We aim to create intentional interactions within the PKU community and with those who influence decisions affecting our community. We have several programs that support this effort:

Community Calls

The NPKUA’s Community Calls are virtual peer support groups offered to a variety of cohorts within the PKU community. Support Programs

Peer Mentor Program

The NPKUA Mentor Program provides as-needed assistance to individuals affected by PKU in a variety of ways––ranging from a quick phone call or email to weekly check-ins, or on-going text support. Support Programs

Advocacy

As an advocate for patients with PKU, you raise awareness, support policy initiatives, and amplify voices within the PKU community to drive positive change and improve quality of life. There are many ways to make your voice heard! For example, you can:
* Join the NPKUA Advocacy Committee
* Share your story to help others fighting to shape legislations
* Organize around issues that are important to our community.
Learn more about ways to be an advocate here .

Affiliates

The Affiliate Council hopes to inspire state and regional PKU organizations, both new and established, to uplift one another as we all work hand-in-hand to improve the lives of people with PKU while pursuing a cure. Learn more about the NPKUA Affiliate groups here .

README.md

Gorse Open-source Recommender System Engine

test codecov Discord Twitter Follow Gurubase
Gorse is an AI powered open-source recommender system written in Go. Gorse aims to be a universal open-source recommender system that can be quickly integrated into a wide variety of online services. By importing items, users, and interaction data into Gorse, the system will automatically train models to generate recommendations for each user. Project features are as follows.
* Multi-source: Recommend items from latest, user-to-user, item-to-item, collaborative filtering and etc.
* Multimodal: Support multimodal content (text, image, videos, etc.) via embedding.
* AI-powered: Support classical recommenders, reranker APIs, and Decision APIs.
* GUI Dashboard: Provide GUI dashboard for recommendation pipeline editing, system monitoring, and data management.

What is the difference between a Firefox Student Ambassador and a Mozilla Rep?

The Firefox Student Ambassador Program exists to support students who are new to the Mozilla community. Once these individuals have gained more knowledge and experience within the community they have the option to apply to the Mozilla Reps program. Although we encourage all Ambassadors to consider applying for higher positions in the FSA Program.

ModelScope aims to build the next-generation open-source Model-as-a-Service sharing platform, providing flexible, easy-to-use, and cost-effective one-stop model services for AI developers, making model applications simpler!

ModelScope partners with domestic AI industry collaborators and academic institutions to promote open-source deep learning models and innovative model service technologies through open community collaboration, driving the prosperity of the model application ecosystem.

Guide

Student and campus tech ambassador programs

How student and campus tech ambassador programs work, who they are for, and how to find vetted listings.
By Davide Carlomagno · Updated 2026-07-25

Why campus programs exist

Companies invest in campus experts and student ambassadors to grow authentic developer communities at universities—clubs, workshops, and peer mentoring—not just coupon codes.

How student and campus tech ambassador programs work, who they are for, and how to find vetted listings.

Companies invest in campus experts and student ambassadors to grow authentic developer communities at universities—clubs, workshops, and peer mentoring—not just coupon codes.

Expect public speaking or workshop practice, community organizing, and content creation. Strong programs offer mentorship, credits, swag, and career visibility—not only referral payouts.

OUR STORY

We started Embedded LLM with a simple goal: make AI practical, fast, and accessible to everyone.
Frustrated by the complexity and cost of deploying large language models, we built JamAI Base—a no-code platform that lets businesses embed LLMs into their workflows in minutes, not months.
Born in Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, our team is redefining how AI is built and used—locally, securely, and efficiently. We’re also growing a community of builders through events like vLLM Asia Developer Day, pushing the edge of what’s possible.
AI shouldn’t be distant. That’s why we’re embedding it.

vLLM everywhere: the fastest engine on any hardware, powering an interoperable, federated AI utility.

## ミッション

LangGeniusは、AIアプリケーション開発の民主化をミッションに掲げ、専門的な知識や高度な開発リソースがなくても、誰もが生成AIを活用したアプリケーションを構築・運用できる環境を提供します。

## ビジョン

産学官におけるAIの研究・実装・社会展開を一気通貫で支援し、日本社会におけるDX、そしてその先にあるAX（AI Transformation）を加速させる。LangGeniusは、日本の産業競争力と社会変革を支えるAIインフラとなることを目指します。

## 解決できる課題

* 01
  
  生成AIネイティブアプリの開発・管理における複雑性
* 02
  
  デプロイのコスト・セキュリティ・可観測性等の主要課題
* 03
  
  AIアプリ構築における専門知識・人材依存
* 04
  
  AI活用が現場まで広がらない組織的制約

工学博士 代表取締役社長 キジ マルダン

代表メッセージ

私たちが目指しているのは、AIを「導入すること」ではありません。  
現場の担当者が、自らAIを作り、使い、改善を回せる状態を当たり前にすることです。  
生成AIは可能性の大きな技術ですが、開発や運用が複雑で、専門人材に依存しがちです。  
その結果、多くの企業でAI活用はPoCで止まり、業務そのものは変わっていません。  
LangGeniusはDifyを基盤に、市民開発という形でこの課題に向き合います。  
業務フローを視覚的に組み、すぐに使い、結果を見てその場で直す。  
改善のスピードを現場に取り戻すことが、DXの先にあるAX（AI Transformation）を現実のものにすると、私たちは考えています。

What is Langflow?

Langflow represents an AI application as a flow of configurable components. Builders can connect models, prompts, agents, tools, data stores, and custom Python components in the visual editor, test either a component or the complete flow, and then serve the result through an API or MCP interface.
Langflow is an open-source, Python-based platform for building AI agents and workflows in a visual editor. It includes API and MCP servers so a flow can be integrated into applications or used as a tool.

The Campus Ambassador Program is a volunteer role for students. Ambassadors hold information tables and respectful conversations about animal welfare, remotely and on campus, for about three to five hours a month during active campaign periods. No experience is required. Apply online or email us.

## LobeHub is Making AI Accessible to Everyone

## We're building the open-source AI platform for everyone

AI used to feel like magic. But for most people, that magic has remained out of reach — locked behind closed ecosystems, expensive APIs, and tools that prioritize vendors over users. We started LobeHub because we believed it didn't have to be this way.

What began as LobeChat, an open-source chatbot framework, has since evolved into a comprehensive AI platform that gives individuals and teams the freedom to use any model, extend with plugins, and own their data. We don't think of LobeHub as just another AI tool — we see it as a better way to interact with AI.

Today, with 700,000+ GitHub stars and contributors from around the world, LobeHub powers everything from personal assistants to enterprise workflows.

...

At the heart of LobeHub is the Agent Harness — an OS-like runtime that sits between the model and your application. Think of the model as the CPU and the context window as RAM.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I have to switch to a new AI to use Composio?

No. Composio works inside the AI you already use, whether that's Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok Bot, Hermes, OpenClaw or your own agent. It gives that AI access to your apps; it isn't another chatbot.

Once you [connect your apps](https://dashboard.composio.dev/login) and add Composio [to your AI](https://composio.dev/works-with), you can ask it to prepare a meeting brief, update your CRM, file issues, post to Slack and much more.

### Which AI assistants does Composio work with?

Composio works out of the box with:

- [ChatGPT / Codex](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a58503580c08191b78cc5bdaf4eba6e) — install Composio in one click.
- [Claude Web / Cowork](https://composio.dev/claude) — connect Composio as a Claude connector.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.composio.dev/docs/claude-code-plugin) — install the Composio plugin.

Hi maintainers,
I am a GPT-SoVITS user and have used the project extensively for Bang Dream voice dubbing experiments. The project has been very useful to me, and I would like to give back to the community by contributing something practical around inference benchmarking and optimization.
I would like to propose a reproducible inference benchmark for GPT-SoVITS.

Motivation

The README reports RTF numbers for v2 ProPlus, and the project has also been adding inference-speed improvements such as CUDA Graph support and frontend/G2PW optimizations.
However, I could not find a standard benchmark script in the repo that decomposes end-to-end inference latency into stages. I think such a benchmark could be useful for both users and contributors, especially for consumer GPU deployments.

Initial Scope

* Hardware: RTX 3060
* Versions: v2, v2Pro, v2ProPlus
* Mode: default non-streaming inference
* Batch size: 1
* Workload: Chinese short / medium / long text cases
* Metrics:
* End-to-end latency
* RTF
* Stage timing:
* text frontend

The organization is the primary maintainer of LiteLLM, a popular open-source AI gateway and Python SDK that provides a unified OpenAI-compatible interface for over 100 LLM providers including Azure, Anthropic, and VertexAI.

AI Apps Have a Memory Problem, and This Fixes It

Soulman

3 min read
·

Note: This article is adapted from the official Phala Network announcement.
Press enter or click to view image in full size
Most AI applications today are stateless by default. Every session starts fresh, context gets lost, and developers end up building custom workarounds just to give their apps a basic sense of continuity. MemPalace is an open-source memory layer built specifically to solve that. It gives AI applications a structured way to store and retrieve memory across sessions, and it ships with benchmarks so developers can measure performance before making any architectural decisions. That last part matters more than it sounds. Most memory solutions ask you to trust the implementation. This one lets you verify it.
MemPalace is available as a deployment template on Phala Cloud, which means you can go from reading about it to having it running in a confidential environment without writing infrastructure from scratch. The template code lives in the Phala Network GitHub repo, and the upstream source is maintained directly by the team. Find the links at the end of this article.

Where the Memory Actually Lives

When you deploy this template on Phala Cloud, your memory datasets, application logic, and workflow

Technology

BMAD SDD

BMAD SDD is an open source, spec driven development framework that structures AI coding agents through rigorous, machine readable specifications to eliminate code drift and vibe coding.
BMAD SDD ( Spec-Driven Development ) transitions software engineering from unpredictable natural language prompting to a structured, contract first workflow . Built as a core component of the open source BMAD Method ecosystem , this framework utilizes machine readable specifications (including OpenAPI schemas, JSON structures, and Gherkin behavior files ) as the single source of truth. Specialized AI agents (covering product, architecture, and development roles) ingest these formal specs to generate, validate , and test code . By enforcing strict human checkpoints and automated verification gates, BMAD SDD ensures that AI generated implementations precisely match business requirements, making it a reliable choice for enterprise scale codebases and regulated environments.

Introduction

Flowise is an open source generative AI development platform for building AI Agents and LLM workflows.
It offers a complete solution that includes:
* [x] Visual Builder
* [x] Tracing & Analytics
* [x] Evaluations
* [x] Human in the Loop
* [x] API, CLI, SDK, Embedded Chatbot
* [x] Teams & Workspaces
There are 3 main visual builders namely:
* Assistant
* Chatflow
* Agentflow

Assistant

Assistant is the most beginner-friendly way of creating an AI Agent. Users can create chat assistant that is able to follow instructions, use tools when necessary, and retrieve knowledge base from uploaded files (RAG) to respond to user queries.

Chatflow

Chatflow is designed to build single-agent systems, chatbots and simple LLM flows. It is more flexible than Assistant. Users can use advance techniques like Graph RAG, Reranker, Retriever, etc.

Agentflow

Agentflow is the superset of Chatflow & Assistant.

Opinion  ·  Education

The Way We Teach Is Broken

The traditional model of education has a serious problem. It was designed to produce compliant workers, not curious thinkers — and it shows. Here's what I think is fundamentally broken about it:
1. Students are made to memorize information purely to pass a test, then promptly forget it.
2. Learning is reduced to parroting what's already in the textbook.
3. Everyone is expected to sit in the same room, at the same pace, for hours — regardless of how they actually learn.
4. Too many teachers aren't equipped well enough to teach the subjects they're assigned.
There are exceptions, of course. Mathematics is one of them — you can't fake your way through it. You have to apply it. The same goes for programming. You write the code, you see the result. The feedback loop is immediate and honest. There's nowhere to hide, and that's exactly what makes it work.

项目介绍

企业级AI低代码平台

JeecgBoot 是一款基于BPM流程和代码生成的AI低代码平台，助力企业快速实现低代码开发和构建AI应用。 采用前后端分离架构（Ant Design&Vue3，SpringBoot3，SpringCloud Alibaba，Mybatis-plus），强大代码生成器实现前后端一键生成，无需手写代码。 平台引领AI低代码开发模式：AI生成→在线编码→代码生成→手工合并，解决Java项目80%重复工作，提升效率，节省成本，兼顾灵活性。 具备强大且颗粒化的权限控制，支持按钮权限和数据权限设置，满足大型业务系统需求。功能涵盖在线表单、表单设计、流程设计、门户设计、报表与大屏设计、OA办公、AI应用、AI知识库、大模型管理、AI流程编排、AI聊天，支持ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Ollama等多种AI大模型。

...

应用平台，涵盖AI应用管理、AI模型管理、智能对话助手、知识库问答、流程编排与设计器、AI建表等多项功能。平台兼容多种主流大模型，包括ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Ollama、智普、千问等，助力企业高效构建智能化应用，推动低代码开发与AI深度融合。
AI驱动开发: 全新推出AI驱动开发能力，支持一句话生成完整系统，提供零代码模式（一句话搭建系统，无需编写代码）和代码生成模式（基于 jeecg-codegen，自动生成完整代码和建表SQL）两种选择。同时支持一句话自动绘制流程图、设计表单，省去手工绘制繁琐步骤。 B站视频演示 | 技能对比与使用说明
JEECG宗旨是: JEECG旨在通过OnlineCoding平台实现简单功能的零代码快速搭建，同时针对复杂功能采用代码生成器生成代码并手工合并，打造智能且灵活的低代码开发模式，有效解决了当前低代码产品普遍缺乏灵活性的问题，提升开发效率的同时兼顾系统的扩展性和定制化能力。
JEECG业务流程: JEECG业务流程采用BPM工作流引擎实现业务审批，扩展任务接口供开发人员编写业务逻辑，表单提供表单设计器、在线配置表单和编码表单等多种解决方案。通过流程与表单的分离设计（松耦合）及任务节点的灵活配置，既保障了企业流程的安全性与保密性，又大幅降低了开发人员的工作量。

I want to introduce Lia. Her name stands for Libre Inteligencia Artificial , and she is powered by LibreChat.
Giving an agent a name and an avatar is easy, and we did this back in 2024. What matters to me is that I now do much of my agentic coding work on LibreChat in LibreChat . The project we have spent years building is becoming a place where we can build the project itself.
Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor have helped me build LibreChat. I do not want our development workflow tied to any of these coding clients. # Gradio: Build Machine Learning Web Apps — in Python

Gradio is an open-source Python package that allows you to quickly **build** a demo or web application for your machine learning model, API, or any arbitrary Python function. You can then **share** a link to your demo or web application in just a few seconds using Gradio's built-in sharing features.

...

You can run Gradio in your favorite code editor, Jupyter notebook, Google Colab, or anywhere else you write Python. Let's write your first Gradio app:

```python
import gradio as gr

def greet(name, intensity):
    return "Hello, " + name + "!" * int(intensity)

demo = gr.Interface(
    fn=greet,
    inputs=["text", "slider"],
    outputs=["text"],
    api_name="predict"
)

demo.launch()
```

We shorten the imported name from `gradio` to `gr` . This is a widely adopted convention for better readability of code.

WiSys Ambassador Program

What Is The Ambassador Program?

The WiSys Ambassador Program aims to enhance the vital connection between WiSys and the research community on Universities of Wisconsin campuses. Engaging students to serve as WiSys Ambassadors brings a new dimension to WiSys’ outreach mission and augments our visibility and presence among researchers and students on each of the campuses we serve.
WiSys Ambassadors receive training in Intellectual Property as well as the technology transfer process, and learn how to access resources offered by WiSys and other campus organizations designed to support technology development and entrepreneurial activity.
WiSys launched the pilot program in August 2014 at UW-Parkside and UW-River Falls and the program is currently available at all Universities of Wisconsin campuses (except Madison and Milwaukee).

What do they do?

* Enhancing the understanding and awareness of WiSys’ role across the campuses.
* Increasing engagement with academics and students undertaking innovative research.
* Helping to identify potential opportunities where WiSys can provide support.
WiSys Ambassadors are involved in organizing seminars, hosting educational workshops, and serving as a valuable resource for their respective departments and campus.

Want to be a WiSys Ambassador?

results.title: About | LAION
excerpts:
ABOUT

We are a non-profit organization with members from all over the world, aiming to make large-scale machine learning models, datasets and related code available to the general public.

OUR BELIEF

We believe that machine learning research and its applications have the potential to have huge positive impacts on our world and therefore should be democratized.

OUR PRINCIPAL GOALS

Releasing open datasets, code and machine learning models. We want to teach the basics of large-scale ML research and data management. By making models, datasets and code reusable without the need to train from scratch all the time, we want to promote an efficient use of energy and computing ressources to face the challenges of climate change.

FUNDING

Funded by donations and public research grants, our aim is to open all cornerstone results from such an important field as large-scale machine learning to all interested communities.

Hello everyone,
Over the past few weeks, I've been working on a collection of standalone addon scripts designed to simplify the Frigate experience, from initial setup to advanced analytics. I'm excited to share them with the community! These tools are all single, self-contained bash scripts that deploy Docker-based web UIs. The goal was to create simple, powerful tools that are easy to install and manage.
Here's a breakdown of the addons:
1. Frigate Easy Install Script This is an all-in-one installer for getting Frigate up and running on a fresh Debian-based system. It automates dependency installation (Docker, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA), generates a YOLOv9 model, and guides the user through the initial setup.
GitHub Repo: https://github.com/kornyhiv/frigatenvr-easyinstallation

# What is SillyTavern?

![SillyTavern - LLM Frontend for Power Users](/static/banner.png)

SillyTavern (or ST for short) is a locally installed user interface that allows you to interact with text generation LLMs, image generation engines, and TTS voice models. Our goal is to empower users with as much utility and control over their LLM prompts as possible, embracing the steep learning curve as part of the fun.

SillyTavern is a passion project brought to you by a dedicated community of LLM enthusiasts and will always be free and open-sourced. Beginning in February 2023 as a fork of TavernAI 1.2.8, SillyTavern now has over 300 contributors and 3 years of independent development under its belt, and continues to serve as a leading software for savvy AI hobbyists.

# About Twigpine. Open-source infrastructure for AI agents.

Every push is signed by the key that made it.Twigpine makes the pieces an agent needs to work on its own: a keypair identity and a git network that accepts its signed pushes, two coding agents, an inference gateway it can pay per request, and a gate that checks it can reason.

The name comes from git itself, which already calls its history a tree: every signed commit is a twig, and the network is the pine that grows from them.

* Posted by Betse Esparza
* Date June 16, 2026
* Categories Features , News , Parent News
Dr. Bernie Cantens, executive vice president and provost at Sul Ross State University, has been selected by the American Association of State Colleges and Universities (AASCU) for its 2026 Millennium Leadership Initiative (MLI) cohort, a premier professional development program for senior-level administrators.
Since 1999, MLI has prepared leaders for executive roles, including college and university presidents and chancellors, through a combination of interactive seminars, peer dialogue, mentorship and executive coaching. The program equips participants with the insight and practical skills necessary to lead effectively in today’s evolving higher education environment.
As part of the yearlong experience, cohort members are paired with seasoned presidents who provide mentorship and opportunities for shadowing, offering firsthand exposure to executive leadership. Participants also benefit from guidance provided by MLI’s President in Residence Mickey Burnim, who serves as a key adviser throughout the program.
MLI has supported the professional growth of 803 leaders since its founding, many of whom have advanced to top executive positions at colleges and universities across the nation. Among these alumni, 174 have gone onto to serve as presidents or chancellors, with several holding multiple appointments over the course of their careers.

Gitleaks is an open-source secret scanning tool used to detect hardcoded credentials such as passwords, API keys, private keys, tokens, and other sensitive values in Git repositories, directories, files, archives, and standard input.

Sim AI 

Open-source visual AI agent builder positioned as a friendlier n8n alternative . Drag-and-drop canvas for connecting nodes (agents, APIs, conditions, functions, knowledge bases, memory, routers) into AI-powered workflows. Multi-model support across the major providers and 60+ pre-built integrations to common SaaS tools.
* GitHub : simstudioai/sim
* Site : sim.ai
* Docs : docs.sim.ai/introduction
* License : Open source (also offers a hosted cloud tier — WorldofAI recommends self-hosting since it’s free)

What It Does 

Sim AI is a visual workflow editor for building AI agents and automations without writing code. Drop nodes onto a canvas, connect them, deploy. Each node is one of:
* Agents — LLM execution blocks; pick the model and prompt
* APIs — call any HTTP endpoint (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE)
* Conditions — branching logic
* Functions — code execution
* Knowledge bases — vector store backed; upload docs or crawl websites
* Memory — persistent state across runs
* Responses — output formatting

# DoltHub

![](/files/dSRcCURl3CcvRspDAabv)

[DoltHub](https://www.dolthub.com) is a place to share Dolt databases. We host public data for free! DoltHub adds a modern, secure, always on database management web GUI to the Dolt ecosystem. Edit your database on the web, have another person review it via a pull request, and have the production database pull it to deploy.

## What is DoltHub

DoltHub is GitHub for Dolt. DoltHub acts as a [Dolt remote](/concepts/dolt/git/remotes.md) you can [clone, push, pull and fetch](/cli-reference/cli.md) from. DoltHub adds [permissions](/concepts/dolthub/permissions.md), [pull requests](/concepts/dolthub/prs.md), [issues](/concepts/dolthub/issues.md), and [forks](/concepts/dolthub/forks.md) to the Dolt ecosystem. Additionally, DoltHub has a modern SQL workbench built in so you can explore and change databases on the web.

## Getting Started

DoltHub has many uses. We recommend getting started by [sharing a database](/products/dolthub/data-sharing.md).

[Data Sharing](/products/dolthub/data-sharing.md)

This documentation will walk you through discovering data on DoltHub, cloning a copy locally, making a change on a fork, and submitting a pull request to the original database.

About modelcontextprotocol.build

This site is an independent developer hub dedicated to providing architectural patterns, security checklists, and implementation examples for the Model Context Protocol.

Our Mission

As the ecosystem around agentic tooling grows, developers need clear, pragmatic, and secure implementation guides. While official repositories define the specifications and schema boundaries , our goal is to show how those boundaries are applied in real-world infrastructure.
We focus heavily on Least Privilege Execution , preventing raw untyped queries from models, and establishing robust operational architectures for LLM-driven environments.

Non-Affiliation Notice

ModelContextProtocol.build operates completely independently. It is not affiliated with, funded by, endorsed by, or managed by Anthropic, the Linux Foundation, the Agentic AI Foundation, or any of their corporate partners. For official information about MCP, always refer to modelcontextprotocol.io .

results.title: Introduction – GraphDeco - Inria
excerpts:
Home Introduction

Introduction

The GraphDeco team is a follow-up of the Reves team .

Overview

Despite significant progress in Computer Graphics, HCI and Computer Vision, creating, manipulating and displaying high-quality visual content remains reserved to a small, well-trained professional elite. We believe that this difficult access is largely due to the core theoretical foundations of Computer Graphics, which were developed for accurate and complete synthetic content. The goal of GraphDeco is to redefine these foundations so they can simultaneously account for both traditional content as well as approximate and incomplete representations captured or produced by casual users. In particular, we plan to explore two main research directions:
* First, the design and artistic principles that guide the creation of visual content need to be automated and redesigned, facilitating professional practices and making such endeavors accessible to all.
* Second, a unified representation is required to develop new computer graphics models and algorithms capable of handling traditional synthetic content as well as inaccurate and incomplete captured data.

Student Ambassador group sitting on benches in front of the greenhouse gardens
Pictured: 2026-2027 Student Ambassador Program
Left to Right: Jacqueline Barrett, Marjorie Green, Olivia Stack, Winnie Kinyanjui, Damian Taylor, Annabelle Calvanese, Alexander Kakembo

Mission

The Student Ambassador Program provides STCC students interested in developing leadership and communication skills with the opportunity to serve as role models, advocates, and peer advisors to fellow students. Ambassadors educate students about the many resources available on campus and encourage involvement and engagement in campus life. Ambassadors work closely with college offices and campus initiatives, including Student Activities & Development and college-wide events and programs.

Application

Students interested in serving as Student Ambassadors are urged to apply during the Spring Semester or summer for the following academic year. The deadline to apply for the 2026-2027 year is Monday, July 6th, 2026.
Student Ambassador Application

Student Ambassador Duties

Duties include, but are not limited to:
* Promoting student success.
* Representing the student community at a variety of internal and external events.
* Assisting new students in becoming oriented, getting involved in student organizations, attending campus events, and making meaningful connections with people in the college community.
* Promoting student resources, activities, and events.

ve since other languages do not require handling argument type errors at runtime. Typed languages catch this at compile-time, and untyped languages don't care about types 😁 . San Francisco, CA, USA
Founded 2024
screenpipe is an open-source application that continuously captures a user's screen and audio, creating a searchable, AI-powered memory of everything done on the computer. It runs locally on the device, extracting text via accessibility APIs and transcribing audio using Whisper, with all data stored in a local SQLite database. The platform supports a plugin system called Pipes for integrations with tools like Obsidian, Notion, and Slack, and exposes an MCP server allowing AI assistants such as Claude and Cursor to query the user's screen history.

*  | Hi HN!
I left Google earlier this year and created Dyad, a local, open-source AI app builder made with Electron.
The motivation: I tried one of the popular cloud-based AI app builders, but when I pulled down the app to run locally and debug in Cursor, it just didn’t work. So I created Dyad, an app builder that runs fully on your computer, making it easy to switch between Dyad and coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code.
Source code: https://github.com/dyad-sh/dyad/
Download (free, no sign-up): https://www.dyad.sh/
I've gotten questions about how it works under the hood so I wrote an architecture doc explaining how it does tool calling using XML tags, etc: https://github.com/dyad-sh/dyad/blob/main/docs/architecture....
Let me know what you think and happy to answer questions about building an Electron app, etc! |
